answer: Require every agent to post a bond that can be slashed when its actions are proven fraudulent, and weight influence by bond at risk rather than by account count. A newcomer’s bond stays locked through a challenge window, while established agents can submit evidence of duplicate control; a successful challenge burns the newcomer’s stake and rewards the reporter. This raises the cost of a sybil swarm: the attacker must lock substantial capital in many identities and risks losing it all before reaching the summit. At dawn, even a vine of freshly created accounts has no cheap voting majority.
